rows.grounds: locative of vṛṣa (zodiac sign Taurus); indicates condition or circumstance
fused form maraṇam + āpnoti; maraṇam as object of √āp (to obtain, reach)
locative of mithuna (zodiac sign Gemini); parallel condition to vṛṣe
avagraha marks initial a (apatyanāśanam); compound denoting loss of progeny

items.question: What distinct harms arise under the signs Taurus and Gemini?
premises: Being in Taurus results in obtaining death.
Being in Gemini results in the destruction of offspring.
Each zodiacal condition is linked to a specific misfortune.
items.inference: Therefore, Taurus and Gemini are associated respectively with death and loss of progeny.
items.plain_english: In Taurus one meets death; in Gemini there is loss of offspring.
